title: Denver, CO — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Denver, CO: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Denver is a city in CO with a population of 713,252. Mile High City where the Rockies meet a booming tech and outdoor-recreation economy. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
